title: Lemma 11.11: effective-epimorphism criteria for Tan-structures
statement_scope: Let X be an ∞-topos and let f:O→O′ be a morphism in Str^loc_Tan(X). The following conditions are equivalent: (1) f is an effective epimorphism in Str^loc_Tan(X); (2) the induced map f^alg:O^alg→O′^alg is an effective epimorphism in Str^loc_Tdisc(C)(X)≃ShvCAlgcn_C(X); (3) the induced map O(C)→O′(C) is an effective epimorphism in X. All three conditions and the whole proof are retained.
